description: Controlled RoboCasa PickPlaceCounterToSink benchmark (seed-0 layout 52/style 13, canned_food_18 target, fixed fixtures/distractors/sink/camera) with far navigation starts and object-pose perturbations; object-relative pregrasp goal. Not a randomly sampled RoboCasa episode.
split_rule: episode_000-049 train, episode_050-099 heldout (fixed before collection); heldout episodes are never used for gradient updates, recoveries, normalization statistics, hyperparameters, early stopping or checkpoint selection

navigation_gate.rule: expert: NAV_ALIGN inside both tolerances, then NAV_SETTLE still inside them; policy evaluation: gate held for 10 consecutive steps

success_thresholds.final_success: RoboCasa PickPlaceCounterToSink._check_success() = obj_inside_of(sink, partial_check=True) and gripper_obj_far

expert_final_hold.rule: _check_success() True and TCP >= min distance, held 10 steps within 30
